records.applicability: http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 is in the Admin application graph only through development tooling: @angular/cli 21.2.26 -> pacote 21.5.1 -> make-fetch-happen 15.0.6 (via npm-registry-fetch, @sigstore/sign and tuf-js). It is not in the production bundle. make-fetch-happen is its only requirer, and that traced consumer constructs every CachePolicy from a module-local `{ shared: false, ignoreCargoCult: true }` (lib/cache/policy.js); the advisory's mechanism needs a shared cache. In the measured runs (load probes, 2026-10-07: build:prod, test:ci, lint and ng version on a disposable copy of 89d2cf1, and build:prod on this change's dependency set) http-cache-semantics, make-fetch-happen and pacote were not loaded. Additional package-operation consumers (pacote under @angular/cli package operations such as ng add and ng update) were source-traced but not exercised. This does not cover a consumer that constructs a shared cache.
records.reason: As of 2026-10-07 no fixed release exists: the advisory (last updated 2026-10-02) lists no patched version. http-cache-semantics 4.3.0 (published 2026-10-04) falls outside the scanner's recorded affected range but leaves the vulnerable max-stale evaluation and shared Set-Cookie handling byte-identical, and a behavioural probe gives the same result on both versions; it is not a fix and is deliberately not installed. Without a disposition the current measured application graph is blocking. The accepted residual risk is that a tooling consumer that was traced but not exercised behaves differently from the measured runs. Remove this record in the same change that installs a release that fixes the mechanism or removes the package from the application graph; from then on it matches nothing and the audit refuses it as stale. It expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-10-31 and is not extended automatically.
